findings.text: The plan section's named id test_unregistered_arc_endpoint_rejects_the_ordinal_compound is renamed to test_unregistered_locus_rejects_the_ordinal_compound, and test_gap_rule_verdicts.py drops the parametrized id test_genuine_demand_still_asks_for_a_token[subject-lithium_6] in favour of test_a_token_the_grammar_now_registers_is_a_false_positive, so two of the seven ids the plan names no longer exist under those names; coverage is preserved and the fragment records the substitution, but a reader searching the plan's id list finds nothing, so the plan record needs the successor names.

The failure_attribution line calls test_manifest_generability.py's three ids and test_catalog_layout_hierarchy::test_export_ledgers_cycle_and_writes_packet 'unchanged by this change', but both head arms (head-suite.log and head-suite-contaminated.log) show them green while the base arm shows them red, and the arms differ only in this node's test and docs commits, which cannot reach them; the base-only band is therefore an artefact of the archive-extracted base tree rather than a sibling's state, and the record should say so.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The change is test-only, so no production definition is reachable from it; the product functions the assertions bind to are classify_gap, describe_gap and is_actionable_gap in imas_codex/standard_names/segments.py.
item_verdicts.diff: The three commits 2df68ed38, 6dfb71cb1 and 686015aec against base 5e28aa87 change two test files and two evidence files, and every assertion change is an updated expectation rather than a removed assertion.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires the seven ids to pass on a compute partition with each diagnosis recorded and no added failure id; head-suite.log reports 1 failed / 8654 passed and the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-red-gap-rules.html records all seven diagnoses.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to make the seven gap-rule and geometry ids red on main pass at their causes; all seven are diagnosed against the installed grammar and the six that keep their ids pass in head-suite.log.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest at r-20261111T221653916562-sph-red-gap-rules/manifest.md records status complete, both suite arms with revisions and log paths, the negative control, and the seven repaired ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The two test files and the two evidence paths in the diff are all inside the six paths the dispatch declared under FENCE — SCOPE.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_gap_rule_verdicts.py:496 asserts classify_gap against the literal "false_positive", so a product regression to "absent" reddens it, but the recorded negative control restores stale expectations rather than mutating the product.
justifications.evidence: tests/standard_names ran on all_debug in both arms with EXIT lines and module/cwd headers recorded in head-suite.log and base-suite.log, but four base-only failures are attributed to a sibling node without being reproduced at head.
justifications.fit: The added comments at tests/standard_names/test_gap_rule_verdicts.py:123 name the grammar mechanism and carry no plan label, sprint id or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Six of the seven named ids pass under their original ids and the geometry id passes as its retargeted successor at tests/standard_names/test_geometry_enumeration_collapse.py:226.
justifications.reuse: The diff adds no product definition; the evidence script docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-red-gap-rules-run.py follows the existing 124-script fragment pattern and no shared provisioning owner exists under scripts/ or tools/.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every one of the four changed paths is inside the six declared write paths, and no product file or plan document was touched.
